mapper.sql: select supplier_id, supplier_code, supplier_name, credit_code, category, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, address, status, admit_date, black_until, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from jc_supplier
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0'
and supplier_name like concat('%', #{supplierName}, '%')
and supplier_code like concat('%', #{supplierCode}, '%')
and credit_code like concat('%', #{creditCode}, '%')
and category = #{category}
and status = #{status}
order by case status when '0' then 0 when '4' then 1 when '3' then 2 when '2' then 3 else 4 end, create_time desc
select count(1) from jc_supplier where del_flag = '0' and supplier_name = #{supplierName}
mapper.insert: insert into jc_supplier ( supplier_code, supplier_name, credit_code, category, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, address, status, admit_date, black_until, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark ) values ( #{supplierCode}, #{supplierName}, #{creditCode}, #{category}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{address}, #{status}, #{admitDate}, #{blackUntil}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: update jc_supplier set del_flag = '1', update_by = 'system', update_time = sysdate() where supplier_id = #{supplierId}
update jc_supplier set status = #{status}, admit_date = #{admitDate}, black_until = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where supplier_id = #{supplierId}
update jc_supplier set status = #{status}, black_until = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.select: select max(supplier_code) from jc_supplier where supplier_code like concat(#{prefix}, '%')

select count(1) as total, sum(status = '0') as pending, sum(status = '1') as normal, sum(status = '2') as observe, sum(status = '3') as deny, sum(status = '4') as black from jc_supplier where del_flag = '0'
select status as name, count(1) as value from jc_supplier where del_flag = '0' group by status order by value desc
select category as name, count(1) as value from jc_supplier where del_flag = '0' and category is not null and category <> '' group by category order by value desc
select config_value from sys_config where config_key = #{configKey}
